minimal_normative_premise.name: MINIMAL_CONTRASTIVE_SUPPORT_NORM
minimal_normative_premise.statement: If evidence E is offered as a reason to favor H over relevant alternatives, mere compatibility with H is insufficient; E must have some contrastive bearing on H relative to the live alternatives.

representation_mediation.key_fact: The match is generated after the preservation map has retained some distinctions and discarded others.

fiber_definitions.C_homogeneous: All members of phi_R^{-1}(s) intersect L fall in the same C-class.
fiber_definitions.C_crossing: The relevant fiber contains live fine structures from more than one C-class.

discrimination_requirement.trigger_use: I_R is offered as positive evidence for same capacity type under declared C.
qualified_if_one_of: Relevant preservation fibers are discriminating with respect to the live C-alternatives.
Independent evidence restricts or differentially weights the C-crossing alternatives so that the identity-support attributed to I_R is warranted.

requirements: current background evidence does not already neutralize the distinction
admitting the rival changes the stated reason for treating I_R as favoring H_C

novelty_claim: Structural comparison has a specific evidence-construction step: a preservation map can silently destroy the contrastive diagnosticity later attributed to the resulting match.
